purpose: Quality gates for premium production. These are guardrails, not a mandate to make every piece busy.

gates.name: Hierarchy clarity
gates.target: Every scene has one obvious primary reading order; no more than two simultaneous high-priority messages.

gates.name: Composition variety
gates.target: At least three materially distinct scene compositions in pieces longer than 20 seconds; no identical card grammar for more than two consecutive scenes.

gates.name: Color discipline
gates.target: Primary brand color should not become the default full-frame surface. Prefer neutral/media-led breathing surfaces unless the brief or Design System explicitly calls for a brand field.

gates.name: Material richness
gates.target: Use at least two purposeful material systems in premium motion longer than 15 seconds, or intentionally choose a quiet single-material direction and document why.

gates.name: Motion purpose
gates.target: Every major motion must explain hierarchy, continuity, state, depth or narrative progression; decorative motion cannot dominate.

gates.name: Transition continuity
gates.target: Prefer transitions that carry an object, mask, baseline, path, camera move or visual state across scenes. Avoid random transition packs.

gates.name: Hero moments
gates.target: Pieces of 20 seconds or more should contain at least one deliberate hero beat or visual payoff rather than maintaining one flat intensity.

gates.name: Depth and spatial staging
gates.target: When compatible with the style, use foreground/background separation, occlusion, parallax, scale or material depth instead of stacking flat cards.

gates.name: Typography as composition
gates.target: Typography must contribute to composition through scale, alignment, weight or staged reveal. Avoid reducing all text to utility labels.

gates.name: Readability and safe areas
gates.target: No microtext, overflow or safe-area violations. Dense information must be staged over time rather than shrunk.

gates.name: Factual separation
gates.target: Facts, official identity and documentary evidence remain deterministic/verified. Generative pixels never fabricate official or documentary reality.
